rows.name: _migration_ledger

  migration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

rows.name: audit_events
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail_json     TEXT NOT NULL,
    prev_checksum   TEXT NOT NULL,
    entry_checksum  TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL
)

rows.name: local_principal_bindings
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE local_principal_bindings (
    binding_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    principal_label  TEXT NOT NULL,
    status           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'REVOKED')),
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    revoked_at       TEXT
)

rows.name: local_principal_memberships
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE local_principal_memberships (
    membership_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    binding_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_principal_bindings(binding_id),
    tenant_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_owner_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
    status              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'REVOKED')),
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    revoked_at          TEXT
)

rows.name: portfolio_contributions
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE portfolio_contributions (
    canonical_owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    portfolio_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    contribution_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount                REAL NOT NULL,
    contributed_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at            TEXT NOT NULL, file_name TEXT, source_broker TEXT, content_digest TEXT, lineage_digest TEXT, imported_at TEXT, contribution_semantics TEXT
  CHECK (contribution_semantics IS NULL OR contribution_semantics IN ('SAVED_NEW_BATCH', 'MERGED_INTO_EXISTING', 'RESET', 'REPLACE')),
    PRIMARY KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, contribution_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id)
        REFERENCES portfolios (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id)
)

rows.name: portfolio_holdings
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE portfolio_holdings (
    canonical_owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    portfolio_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision              INTEGER NOT NULL,
    holding_key           TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol                TEXT NOT NULL,
    company_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity              REAL NOT NULL,
    average_buy_price     REAL NOT NULL,
    current_price         REAL NOT NULL,
    market_value          REAL NOT NULL,
    weight_percentage     REAL NOT NULL,
    active                INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    source_broker         TEXT NOT NULL,
    lineage_digest        TEXT NOT NULL,
    identity_status       TEXT,
    resolution_disposition TEXT,
    created_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    security_identity     TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision, holding_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision)
        REFERENCES portfolio_revisions (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision)
)

rows.name: portfolio_restore_receipts
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE portfolio_restore_receipts (
 canonical_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, portfolio_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
 restored_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, restored_at TEXT NOT NULL, is_saved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_saved IN (0,1)),
 PRIMARY KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, idempotency_key),
 UNIQUE (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, restored_revision),
 FOREIGN KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, restored_revision)
 REFERENCES portfolio_revisions (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision)
)

rows.name: portfolio_revisions
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE "portfolio_revisions" (
    portfolio_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision              INTEGER NOT NULL,
    operation             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('INITIAL', 'MERGE', 'REPLACE', 'RESET', 'DELETE', 'RESTORE')),
    total_market_value    REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    weight_sum_percentage REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    holdings_count        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    provenance_digest     TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_digest        TEXT,
    created_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id)
        REFERENCES portfolios (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id)
)

rows.name: portfolios
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE portfolios (
    portfolio_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    tenant_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    portfolio_name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_revision      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'TOMBSTONED')),
    created_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted_at            TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id)
)

statements.title: Principal bindings inventory
Principal memberships inventory joined to parent bindings
statements.sql:
SELECT m.membership_id, m.binding_id, m.tenant_id, m.canonical_owner_id, m.status,
       m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.revoked_at,
       b.principal_label AS parent_principal_label, b.status AS parent_binding_status
FROM local_principal_memberships m
LEFT JOIN local_principal_bindings b ON b.binding_id = m.binding_id
ORDER BY m.membership_id ASC;

statements.title: Portfolio headers and explicit owner/tenant/status classification
statements.sql:
SELECT canonical_owner_id, tenant_id, portfolio_id, portfolio_name,
       current_revision, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at,
       CASE
         WHEN canonical_owner_id = 'ipd-owner-ramki-personal' AND tenant_id = 'ipd-personal-local'
           THEN 'CANDIDATE_S1_HISTORICAL_PORTFOLIO'
         WHEN canonical_owner_id = 'owner-4dc756b3' AND tenant_id = 'ipd-personal-local'
           THEN 'EXISTING_D02_OWNER_PORTFOLIO'
         ELSE 'UNRESOLVED_OTHER_OWNER_OR_TENANT'
       END AS d16_classification
FROM portfolios
ORDER BY canonical_owner_id ASC, tenant_id ASC, portfolio_id ASC;

statements.title: Portfolio holdings summary by owner, portfolio, revision, broker, and security identity status
statements.sql:
SELECT canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision,
       source_broker, active, identity_status, resolution_disposition,
       CASE WHEN security_identity IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'POPULATED' END AS security_identity_state,
       COUNT(*) AS holding_rows
FROM portfolio_holdings
GROUP BY canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision,
         source_broker, active, identity_status, resolution_disposition, security_identity_state
ORDER BY canonical_owner_id ASC, portfolio_id ASC, revision ASC, source_broker ASC;

statements.title: Collision check (a): identical portfolio_id across S1 and D02 owners
statements.sql:
SELECT s1.portfolio_id,
       s1.tenant_id AS s1_tenant_id, s1.status AS s1_status, s1.current_revision AS s1_revision,
       d02.tenant_id AS d02_tenant_id, d02.status AS d02_status, d02.current_revision AS d02_revision
FROM portfolios s1
INNER JOIN portfolios d02
  ON d02.portfolio_id = s1.portfolio_id
WHERE s1.canonical_owner_id = 'ipd-owner-ramki-personal'
  AND d02.canonical_owner_id = 'owner-4dc756b3';

statements.title: Collision check (b): duplicate normalized symbols within any (canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision)
statements.sql:
SELECT canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision, upper(trim(symbol)) AS norm_symbol, COUNT(*) AS dup_count
FROM portfolio_holdings
GROUP BY canonical_owner_id, portfolio_id, revision, upper(trim(symbol))
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

statements.title: Collision check (c): active binding / active membership partial-unique invariant
statements.sql:
SELECT 'ACTIVE_BINDINGS' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS active_count
FROM local_principal_bindings WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIPS' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS active_count
FROM local_principal_memberships WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';

statements.title: Orphan/consistency check (a): memberships referencing missing or non-ACTIVE bindings
statements.sql:
SELECT m.membership_id, m.binding_id, m.status AS membership_status, b.status AS binding_status
FROM local_principal_memberships m
LEFT JOIN local_principal_bindings b ON b.binding_id = m.binding_id
WHERE b.binding_id IS NULL OR (m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status <> 'ACTIVE');

statements.title: Orphan/consistency check (b): portfolios whose current_revision has no matching portfolio_revisions row or inconsistent status
statements.sql:
SELECT p.canonical_owner_id, p.portfolio_id, p.status, p.current_revision, p.deleted_at,
       r.revision AS matched_revision, r.operation AS current_operation
FROM portfolios p
LEFT JOIN portfolio_revisions r
  ON r.canonical_owner_id = p.canonical_owner_id
 AND r.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id
 AND r.revision = p.current_revision
WHERE (p.current_revision > 0 AND r.revision IS NULL)
   OR (p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.operation = 'DELETE')
   OR (p.status = 'TOMBSTONED' AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL OR r.operation <> 'DELETE'));

statements.title: Orphan/consistency check (c): portfolio_revisions whose holdings_count disagrees with actual portfolio_holdings rows
statements.sql:
SELECT r.canonical_owner_id, r.portfolio_id, r.revision, r.operation,
       r.holdings_count AS declared_count, COUNT(h.holding_key) AS actual_count
FROM portfolio_revisions r
LEFT JOIN portfolio_holdings h
  ON h.canonical_owner_id = r.canonical_owner_id
 AND h.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id
 AND h.revision = r.revision
GROUP BY r.canonical_owner_id, r.portfolio_id, r.revision, r.operation, r.holdings_count
HAVING r.holdings_count <> COUNT(h.holding_key);
